MTKMesh.doc: A container for the vertex data of a Model I/O mesh, suitable for use in a Metal app.

MTKMeshBuffer.doc: A buffer that backs the vertex data of a Model I/O mesh, suitable for use in a Metal app.

MTKMeshBufferAllocator.doc: An interface for allocating a MetalKit buffer that backs the vertex data of a Model I/O mesh, suitable for use in a Metal app.

MTKSubmesh.doc: A container for the index data of a Model I/O submesh, suitable for use in a Metal app.

MTKTextureLoader.doc: An object that creates textures from existing data in common image formats.

MTKView.doc: A specialized view that creates, configures, and displays Metal objects.

MTKViewDelegate.doc: Methods for responding to a MetalKit view’s drawing and resizing events.

+newMeshesFromAsset:device:sourceMeshes:.doc: Creates and initializes MetalKit meshes from all Model I/O meshes in a Model I/O asset.

-initWithMesh:device:error:.doc: Initializes a MetalKit mesh and its submeshes from a Model I/O mesh.

-initWithDevice:.doc: Initializes a new texture loader object.

-newTextureWithCGImage:options:completio.doc: Asynchronously loads image data and creates a new Metal texture from a given bitmap image.

-newTextureWithCGImage:options:error:.doc: Synchronously loads image data and creates a new Metal texture from a given bitmap image.

-newTextureWithContentsOfURL:options:com.doc: Asynchronously loads image data and creates a new Metal texture from a given URL.

-newTextureWithContentsOfURL:options:err.doc: Synchronously loads image data and creates a new Metal texture from a given URL.

-newTextureWithData:options:completionHa.doc: Asynchronously creates a new Metal texture from an in-memory representation of the texture’s data.

-newTextureWithData:options:error:.doc: Synchronously creates a new Metal texture from an in-memory representation of the texture’s data.

-newTextureWithMDLTexture:options:comple.doc: Asynchronously loads image data and creates a Metal texture from the specified Model I/O texture.

-newTextureWithMDLTexture:options:error:.doc: Synchronously loads image data and creates a Metal texture from the specified Model I/O texture.

-newTextureWithName:scaleFactor:bundle:o.doc: Asynchronously loads image data and creates a Metal texture from the named texture asset in an asset catalog.
Synchronously loads image data and creates a Metal texture from the named texture asset in an asset catalog.

-newTextureWithName:scaleFactor:displayG.doc: Asynchronously loads image data and creates a Metal texture from the named texture asset in an asset catalog.
Synchronously loads image data and creates a Metal texture from the named texture asset in an asset catalog, using a specified display gamut.

-newTexturesWithContentsOfURLs:options:c.doc: Asynchronously loads image data and creates new Metal textures from the specified list of URLs.

-newTexturesWithContentsOfURLs:options:e.doc: Synchronously loads image data and creates new Metal textures from the specified list of URLs.

-newTexturesWithNames:scaleFactor:bundle.doc: Asynchronously loads image data and creates Metal textures from the specified list of named texture assets in an asset catalog.

-newTexturesWithNames:scaleFactor:displa.doc: Asynchronously loads image data and creates Metal textures from the specified list of named texture assets in an asset catalog.

-initWithCoder:.doc: Initializes a view from data in a given unarchiver.

-initWithFrame:device:.doc: Initializes a view with the specified frame rectangle and Metal device.

-releaseDrawables.doc: Releases the depthStencilTexture and multisampleColorTexture objects.

submeshes.doc: An array of submeshes containing index buffers referencing the mesh vertices.

vertexBuffers.doc: An array of buffers in which mesh vertex data resides.

vertexCount.doc: The number of vertices in the vertex buffers.

vertexDescriptor.doc: A Model I/O vertex descriptor specifying the data layout in the vertex buffers.

allocator.doc: The allocator object used to create this mesh buffer.

buffer.doc: The Metal buffer backing all vertex and index data.

length.doc: The logical size of the Metal buffer, in bytes.

offset.doc: The byte offset of the data within the Metal buffer.

type.doc: The type of data contained in the originating Model I/O buffer.

zone.doc: The zone, if any, from which this mesh buffer was created.

device.doc: The device used to create Metal objects.

indexBuffer.doc: The index buffer used to render the submesh object.

indexCount.doc: The number of indices in the index buffer.

indexType.doc: The type of index data in the index buffer.

mesh.doc: The parent mesh containing the vertex data of this submesh.

primitiveType.doc: The primitive type with which to draw the submesh object.

MTKTextureLoaderArrayCallback.doc: The signature for the block executed after an asynchronous loading operation for multiple textures has completed.

MTKTextureLoaderCallback.doc: The signature for the block executed after an asynchronous loading operation for a single texture has completed.

MTKTextureLoaderError.doc: Errors returned by the texture loader.

MTKTextureLoaderOption.doc: Keys and values used to specify loading options.

device.doc: The device object that the texture loader uses to create textures.

autoResizeDrawable.doc: A Boolean value that controls whether to resize the drawable as the view changes size.

clearColor.doc: The color to use to clear the color target when creating a render pass descriptor.

clearDepth.doc: The depth value to use to clear the depth target when creating a render pass descriptor.

clearStencil.doc: The stencil value to use to clear the stencil target when creating a render pass descriptor.

colorPixelFormat.doc: The color pixel format for the current drawable’s texture.

colorspace.doc: The color space of the rendered content.

currentDrawable.doc: The drawable to use for the current frame.

currentRenderPassDescriptor.doc: A render pass descriptor to draw into the current drawable.

depthStencilAttachmentTextureUsage.doc: The texture usage characteristics that the view uses when creating the depth and stencil textures.

depthStencilPixelFormat.doc: The format used to generate the depthStencilTexture object.

depthStencilStorageMode.doc: The storage mode that the packed depth and stencil texture use.

depthStencilTexture.doc: A packed depth and stencil texture associated with the current drawable object’s texture.

device.doc: The device object the view uses to create its Metal objects.

drawableSize.doc: The current size of drawable textures.

enableSetNeedsDisplay.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the view responds to setNeedsDisplay.

framebufferOnly.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the drawable’s textures are used only for rendering.

multisampleColorAttachmentTextureUsage.doc: The texture usage characteristics that the view uses when creating multisample textures.

multisampleColorTexture.doc: The multisample color sample texture to render into.

paused.doc: A Boolean value that indicates whether the draw loop is paused.

preferredDevice.doc: The device object that the system recommends using for this view.

preferredDrawableSize.doc: The recommended dimensions of the drawable.

preferredFramesPerSecond.doc: The rate at which the view redraws its contents.

presentsWithTransaction.doc: A Boolean value that determines whether the view presents its content using a Core Animation transaction.

sampleCount.doc: The sample count used to generate the multisampleColorTexture object.
